call_questions: If the current tax and regulatory regime stays exactly as it is for five years, what does Coinlane look like?
What happens the day your payment partner or bank pulls the fiat on-ramp?
What are 30- and 90-day retention and cost per retained user for referral-acquired users?
Why would a user pick Coinlane over the largest Indian exchanges?
You've said the rules will get friendlier - make the strongest case that they won't, and tell us what you would build then.
what_would_change_our_view: A business that works under today's rules - with a fallback if regulation does not improve - plus retention data showing users stay without referral incentives.
